defaultContent.title: Fees, Day Care timings and transport
defaultContent.lead: Information below is published only after the school approves it. Where it is not yet published, ask the admissions team for current details.

items.title: Fees
items.text: Current fees for the session you are applying to are shared directly by the admissions office. Please ask for the current fee schedule for your child's class.

items.title: Day Care timings
items.text: Day Care schedules are confirmed by the school. Please ask for the current timings and available plans.

items.title: Transport
items.text: Transport availability depends on your route and location. Please share your area to ask whether a route is currently available.
